source_notes: WHO. GLASS whole-genome sequencing for surveillance of antimicrobial resistance. Geneva, 2020. ISBN 9789240011007.
WHO. GLASS: the detection and reporting of colistin resistance (2nd ed). WHO/WSI/AMR/2018.4.
WHO. GLASS Emerging Antimicrobial Resistance Reporting framework (GLASS-EAR). ISBN 9789241514590.
WHO. Bacterial Priority Pathogens List 2024. ISBN 9789240093461.
WHO. Catalogue of mutations in Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex and their association with drug resistance, 2nd ed. Geneva, 2023. ISBN 9789240082410.

ICMR. Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance and Research Network (AMRSN) annual reports; blaNDM and blaOXA-48-like (predominantly NDM-1 and OXA-181) are the dominant carbapenemases reported from Indian centres.
Reference databases named by WHO GLASS-WGS for determinant calling and typing: NCBI AMRFinderPlus, ResFinder/PointFinder, CARD, PubMLST (MLST/cgMLST), NCBI Pathogen Detection.
Marker entries are a configurable starting catalogue for local surveillance. Clinical interpretation, validation and reporting policy remain the responsibility of the laboratory.

markers.name: blaNDM (New Delhi metallo-β-lactamase)
markers.predicted_resistance: All β-lactams except aztreonam-containing regimens; not inhibited by avibactam or vaborbactam

markers.name: blaKPC (Klebsiella pneumoniae carbapenemase)
markers.predicted_resistance: Carbapenems and most β-lactams; usually inhibited by avibactam, vaborbactam, relebactam

markers.name: blaOXA-48-like (incl. OXA-181, OXA-232)
markers.predicted_resistance: Carbapenems (often low-level); temocillin; spares expanded-spectrum cephalosporins unless ESBL co-carried
markers.reporting_standard: WHO GLASS-WGS; ICMR-AMRSN (OXA-181 predominant in India)

markers.name: blaVIM (Verona integron-encoded MBL)
markers.predicted_resistance: All β-lactams except aztreonam-containing regimens

markers.name: blaIMP (imipenemase MBL)
markers.predicted_resistance: All β-lactams except aztreonam-containing regimens

markers.name: blaOXA-23-like
markers.predicted_resistance: Carbapenems; principal acquired carbapenemase in A. baumannii

markers.name: blaOXA-24/40-like
markers.predicted_resistance: Carbapenems

markers.name: blaOXA-58-like
markers.predicted_resistance: Carbapenems, expression dependent on upstream insertion sequences

markers.name: blaOXA-51-like (species marker)
markers.mechanism_class: Intrinsic class D β-lactamase used for species confirmation
markers.predicted_resistance: Not a resistance predictor on its own; carbapenem resistance requires an upstream ISAba1 promoter

markers.name: blaCTX-M (group 1 / group 9)
markers.predicted_resistance: Third-generation cephalosporins; dominant ESBL family worldwide

markers.name: blaSHV (ESBL variants)
markers.predicted_resistance: Penicillins; extended-spectrum cephalosporins for ESBL variants only

markers.name: blaTEM (ESBL variants)
markers.predicted_resistance: Aminopenicillins; extended-spectrum cephalosporins for ESBL variants only

markers.name: blaCMY (plasmid AmpC)
markers.predicted_resistance: Cephamycins and third-generation cephalosporins; not inhibited by clavulanate

markers.name: blaDHA (plasmid AmpC)
markers.predicted_resistance: Cephamycins and third-generation cephalosporins

markers.name: Chromosomal AmpC derepression (ampC/ampD/ampR)
markers.organism_scope: Enterobacter spp.; Citrobacter freundii; Serratia spp.; Pseudomonas aeruginosa
markers.predicted_resistance: Third-generation cephalosporins on therapy; supports cautious reporting

markers.name: mcr-1 to mcr-10 (mobile colistin resistance)
markers.organism_scope: Enterobacterales; One Health relevant (human, animal, environment)
markers.predicted_resistance: Colistin and polymyxin B
markers.reporting_standard: WHO GLASS colistin detection and reporting guidance; GLASS-EAR notifiable

markers.name: mgrB / pmrAB / phoPQ disruption
markers.predicted_resistance: Colistin (chromosomal, non-transferable)
markers.reporting_standard: WHO GLASS colistin detection and reporting guidance

markers.name: mecA (methicillin resistance)
markers.predicted_resistance: All β-lactams except anti-MRSA cephalosporins; defines MRSA

markers.name: mecC (divergent mec homologue)
markers.predicted_resistance: β-lactams; may be missed by mecA-only PCR and by some PBP2a agglutination kits

markers.name: Panton-Valentine leukocidin (lukS-PV/lukF-PV)
markers.predicted_resistance: Not a resistance marker; flags necrotising infection risk

markers.name: vanA (glycopeptide resistance)
markers.predicted_resistance: Vancomycin and teicoplanin, high level

markers.name: vanB (glycopeptide resistance)
markers.predicted_resistance: Vancomycin, variable level; teicoplanin usually retained

markers.name: vanC (intrinsic)
markers.predicted_resistance: Low-level vancomycin; intrinsic, supports species confirmation

markers.name: 16S rRNA methyltransferases (armA, rmtB, rmtC, npmA)
markers.predicted_resistance: Pan-aminoglycoside resistance including amikacin, gentamicin, tobramycin, plazomicin

markers.name: aac(6')-Ib-cr
markers.predicted_resistance: Reduced susceptibility to ciprofloxacin and to amikacin/tobramycin

markers.name: qnrA / qnrB / qnrS (PMQR)
markers.predicted_resistance: Reduced fluoroquinolone susceptibility; facilitates selection of higher-level resistance

markers.name: gyrA / parC QRDR mutations
markers.organism_scope: Enterobacterales; Salmonella Typhi; Neisseria gonorrhoeae; Campylobacter spp.
markers.predicted_resistance: Fluoroquinolones; principal mechanism in typhoidal Salmonella
markers.reporting_standard: WHO BPPL 2024 (high: fluoroquinolone-resistant S. Typhi, Shigella, NTS)

markers.name: penA mosaic allele
markers.predicted_resistance: Reduced susceptibility to ceftriaxone and cefixime
markers.reporting_standard: WHO BPPL 2024 (high: 3GC-resistant N. gonorrhoeae); WHO GASP

markers.name: 23S rRNA A2059G / C2611T
markers.predicted_resistance: Azithromycin

markers.name: ermB / mefA
markers.predicted_resistance: Macrolides; ermB additionally clindamycin (MLSb)

markers.name: cfr / optrA / poxtA (oxazolidinone)
markers.predicted_resistance: Linezolid, tedizolid; phenicols

markers.name: tet(X3)/tet(X4) (tigecycline)
markers.predicted_resistance: Tigecycline and all tetracyclines

markers.name: rpoB RRDR mutation (rifampicin)
markers.predicted_resistance: Rifampicin; defines RR-TB and triggers MDR/RR-TB treatment pathways
markers.reporting_standard: WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC, 2nd ed (2023); WHO BPPL 2024 (critical: RR-TB)

markers.name: katG / inhA promoter mutation (isoniazid)
markers.predicted_resistance: Isoniazid; inhA promoter changes also affect ethionamide
markers.reporting_standard: WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC, 2nd ed (2023)

markers.name: gyrA / gyrB mutation (fluoroquinolone, MTBC)
markers.predicted_resistance: Levofloxacin, moxifloxacin; defines pre-XDR when with RR-TB
markers.reporting_standard: WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC, 2nd ed (2023)

markers.name: rrs / eis mutation (amikacin, kanamycin)
markers.mechanism_class: Ribosomal target mutation / aminoglycoside acetyltransferase overexpression
markers.predicted_resistance: Amikacin, kanamycin, capreomycin
markers.reporting_standard: WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC, 2nd ed (2023)

markers.name: pncA mutation (pyrazinamide)
markers.predicted_resistance: Pyrazinamide
markers.reporting_standard: WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC, 2nd ed (2023)

markers.name: Rv0678 / atpE / pepQ mutation (bedaquiline)
markers.predicted_resistance: Bedaquiline; cross-resistance with clofazimine for Rv0678
markers.reporting_standard: WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC, 2nd ed (2023)

markers.name: rrl / rplC mutation (linezolid, MTBC)
markers.predicted_resistance: Linezolid
markers.reporting_standard: WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC, 2nd ed (2023)

markers.name: Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra
markers.predicted_resistance: MTB detection with rifampicin resistance call

markers.name: Xpert Carba-R
markers.predicted_resistance: Five carbapenemase families in one run
markers.reporting_standard: Used in Indian centres for early carbapenemase detection

markers.name: Line probe assay (MTBDRplus / MTBDRsl)
markers.gene_symbol: rpoB, katG, inhA, gyrA, gyrB, rrs, eis
markers.predicted_resistance: First-line and second-line TB drug resistance

markers.name: Targeted next-generation sequencing (TB drug resistance)
markers.predicted_resistance: Broad first- and second-line resistance profile direct from specimen
markers.reporting_standard: WHO catalogue of mutations in MTBC, 2nd ed (2023) — interpretation reference

markers.name: Carbapenemase multiplex PCR (5-family)
markers.predicted_resistance: Carbapenemase family assignment

markers.name: MLST sequence type
markers.organism_scope: All cultured bacteria with a PubMLST scheme
markers.predicted_resistance: Not a resistance marker; identifies high-risk clones (e.g. K. pneumoniae ST258, ST147, E. coli ST131)

markers.name: cgMLST / wgMLST profile
markers.organism_scope: All cultured bacteria with a scheme
markers.predicted_resistance: Not a resistance marker; outbreak clustering and transmission inference

markers.name: SNP-distance cluster assignment
markers.predicted_resistance: Not a resistance marker; outbreak confirmation

markers.name: Plasmid replicon type (Inc typing)
markers.predicted_resistance: Not a resistance marker; characterises the vehicle carrying carbapenemase or mcr genes

markers.name: MALDI-TOF species identification
markers.predicted_resistance: Not a resistance marker; records identification score and database version
markers.reporting_standard: Routine identification; record score and library version

markers.name: 16S rRNA gene sequencing
markers.predicted_resistance: Not a resistance marker; genus/species assignment where MALDI-TOF is unresolved

markers.name: WGS-based species identification and AMR determinant call
markers.predicted_resistance: Full acquired-determinant profile; call with AMRFinderPlus, ResFinder/PointFinder or CARD and record tool plus database version

markers.name: Clinical metagenomic sequencing
markers.organism_scope: Sterile-site and complex specimens; environmental One Health samples
markers.predicted_resistance: Organism detection and resistome profile without culture; interpret with local validation
markers.reporting_standard: WHO global genomic surveillance strategy for pathogens with pandemic and epidemic potential 2022-2032
